name: Traveler
description: Resonant low-pass filter emulating the Korg AX1500G / Keio Traveler F-1 (MS20-style VCF). Expression pedal sweeps the cutoff; an optional LFO adds the classic 'traveler' wobble.

params.name: Cutoff
params.explanation: Base cutoff frequency, 60 Hz (0) to 8 kHz (100), log scale. Assign the expression pedal to this knob to sweep it.

params.name: Res
params.explanation: Resonance. Higher = peakier, more MS20-style ring at the cutoff.

params.name: Sweep
params.explanation: LFO depth added to the cutoff (0 = none, 100 = +/-2500 Hz). The 'traveler' wobble.
